stops.title: Vectors, collinearity, coplanarity & section formula
stops.inShort: Unit vector û = u / |u|. Section formula for internal division in ratio m:n: r = (m b + n a)/(m + n). Three vectors are coplanar iff their scalar triple product [a b c] = 0.

stops.title: Scalar (dot) product & direction cosines
stops.inShort: a · b = |a||b| cos θ. Orthogonal iff a · b = 0. Projection of a on b = (a · b)/|b|. Direction cosines l = cos α, m = cos β, n = cos γ satisfy l² + m² + n² = 1.

cards.text: a · b = |a||b| cos θ. Two non-zero vectors are perpendicular iff a · b = 0.

stops.title: Vector (cross) product & Scalar/Vector triple product
stops.inShort: |a × b| = |a||b| sin θ. Area of triangle = ½ |AB × AC|. Volume of parallelepiped = |[a b c]|; volume of tetrahedron = (1/6)|[a b c]|. Lagrange's identity: |a × b|² + (a · b)² = |a|² |b|².

board.text: If |a| = 5, |b| = 13 and |a × b| = 25 then |a · b| is equal to ____.
Write unit vector in the opposite direction to u = 8i + 3j − k.
The area of the triangle with vertices (1, 2, 0), (1, 0, 2) and (0, 3, 1) in sq. unit is ____.
The value of i · (j × k) + j · (k × i) + k · (i × j) is ____.
board.answer: (d) 3 (each scalar triple product i·i + j·j + k·k = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3).
